40011242.author: पदार्थः
40011242.content: अथ and then, अङ्गदवचः Angada's words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, गजः Gaja, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, मैन्दश्च Mainda, द्विविदश्चैव even Dvivida, सुषेणः Sushena, तथा so also, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, सर्वे all, ते them, वानरर्षभाः bulls among monkeys, यथाक्रमम् following an order, तत्र there, गतौ in turn the scope for, स्वं स्वम् on their own, समुत्साहम् capability (to leap), ऊचुः expressed.

40011242.author: Translation
40011242.content: Thereafter, on hearing Angada, all the leaders among the monkeys, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Mainda, Dvivida, Sushena and Jambavan as well expressed one after  the other their capability for leaping.

40011243.author: पदार्थः
40011243.content: अथ and then, अङ्गदवचः Angada's words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, गजः Gaja, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, मैन्दश्च Mainda, द्विविदश्चैव even Dvivida, सुषेणः Sushena, तथा so also, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, सर्वे all, ते them, वानरर्षभाः bulls among monkeys, यथाक्रमम् following an order, तत्र there, गतौ in turn the scope for, स्वं स्वम् on their own, समुत्साहम् capability (to leap), ऊचुः expressed.

40011243.content: Thereafter, on hearing Angada, all the leaders among the monkeys, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Mainda, Dvivida, Sushena and Jambavan as well expressed one after  the other their capability for leaping.

40011243.author: सारांशः
40011243.content: Each of the monkey leaders declares the distance they can fly -- Jambavan resolves not to send Angada but send Hanuman instead to cross.

40011244.author: पदार्थः
40011244.content: तत्र after that, गजः Gaja, दशयोजनम् ten yojanas, प्लवेयम् I can leap, आबभाषे said, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, विंशतिम् twenty, योजनानि yojanas, गमिष्यामि I can go, इति thus, आह said.

40011244.author: Translation
40011244.content: Gaja said he can leap ten yojanas and Gavaksha said he can go upto twenty yojanas.

40011245.author: पदार्थः
40011245.content: तत्र there, गवयो Gava, वानरः monkeys, तान् वानरान् the monkeys, उवाच ह said like that, प्लवङ्गमाः O leaping monkeys, योजनानाम्  yojanas, त्रिंशतम् thirty, गमिष्यामि I can reach, तत्र there, शरभः Sarabha, वानरर्षभ great monkey, तान् वानरान् those monkeys, उवाच ह said, योजनानाम् yojanas, चत्वारिंशत् forty, गमिष्यामि can reach, संशयः doubt, न without, महातेजाः bright, गन्धमादनः Ghandamadana, वानरान् monkeys, अब्रवीत् said, योजनानाम् yojanas, पञ्चाशत् fifty, गमिष्यामि I can go, संशयः doubt, न no, तत्र there, मैन्दः Mainda, वानरस्तु to the monkeys, तान् वानरान् those monkeys, उवाच ह said, अहम् I, योजनानाम् of yojanas, षष्टिं परम् more than sixty, प्लवितुम् to leap, उत्सहे I am enthusiastic, ततः then, महातेजाः highly brilliant, द्विविदः Dvivida, तत्र there, प्रत्यभाषत in turn spoke, अहम् I, सप्तति: seventy, योजनानि yojanas, गमिष्यामि I can go, सन्देहः doubt, न not, महातेजाः brilliant, सत्त्ववान् strong, सुषेणः Sushena, कपिसत्तमः best among the monkeys, अहम् I, पराक्रमे capability, योजनानाम् of yojanas, अशीतिम् eighty, प्लवेयं I can leap.

40011245.author: Translation
40011245.content: Then Gavaya said to the monkeys 'I can leap thirty yojanas Sarabha said 'I can leap forty yojanas' bright Ghandhamadana said 'I can leap as far as fifty yojanas without any doubt' Mainda said 'I can leap more than sixty yojanas' highly brilliant Dvivida said in turn, 'I can no doubt leap seventy yojanas ' brilliant and best of the monkeys Sushena declared 'I can leap across eighty yojanas'.

40011250.content: तत्र there, गवयो Gava, वानरः monkeys, तान् वानरान् the monkeys, उवाच ह said like that, प्लवङ्गमाः O leaping monkeys, योजनानाम्  yojanas, त्रिंशतम् thirty, गमिष्यामि I can reach, तत्र there, शरभः Sarabha, वानरर्षभ great monkey, तान् वानरान् those monkeys, उवाच ह said, योजनानाम् yojanas, चत्वारिंशत् forty, गमिष्यामि can reach, संशयः doubt, न without, महातेजाः bright, गन्धमादनः Ghandamadana, वानरान् monkeys, अब्रवीत् said, योजनानाम् yojanas, पञ्चाशत् fifty, गमिष्यामि I can go, संशयः doubt, न no, तत्र there, मैन्दः Mainda, वानरस्तु to the monkeys, तान् वानरान् those monkeys, उवाच ह said, अहम् I, योजनानाम् of yojanas, षष्टिं परम् more than sixty, प्लवितुम् to leap, उत्सहे I am enthusiastic, ततः then, महातेजाः highly brilliant, द्विविदः Dvivida, तत्र there, प्रत्यभाषत in turn spoke, अहम् I, सप्तति: seventy, योजनानि yojanas, गमिष्यामि I can go, सन्देहः doubt, न not, महातेजाः brilliant, सत्त्ववान् strong, सुषेणः Sushena, कपिसत्तमः best among the monkeys, अहम् I, पराक्रमे capability, योजनानाम् of yojanas, अशीतिम् eighty, प्लवेयं I can leap.

40011250.content: Then Gavaya said to the monkeys 'I can leap thirty yojanas Sarabha said 'I can leap forty yojanas' bright Ghandhamadana said 'I can leap as far as fifty yojanas without any doubt' Mainda said 'I can leap more than sixty yojanas' highly brilliant Dvivida said in turn, 'I can no doubt leap seventy yojanas ' brilliant and best of the monkeys Sushena declared 'I can leap across eighty yojanas'.

40011251.author: पदार्थः
40011251.content: ततः then, तेषाम् among them, वृद्धतमः oldest, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, तेषाम् they, तत्र there, कथयताम् (when they were) saying, तान् सर्वान् all the, अनुमान्य inferred, प्रत्यभाषत replied.

40011251.author: Translation
40011251.content: When the monkeys were talking (of their individual capacity) in that manner about their speed, Jambavan the oldest of the monkeys inferred (their capacity) and said:

40011252.author: पदार्थः
40011252.content: पूर्वम् earlier, अस्माकमपि even I also, कश्चित् some, गतिपराक्रमः very courageous, आसीत् had , ते वयम् for me, साम्प्रतम् attained, वयसः (old) age, पारम् fag end of life, अनुप्राप्ताः स्म have reached.

40011252.author: Translation
40011252.content: 'Earlier I was also very courageous, but now I have become old and reached the fag end of life.

40011253.author: पदार्थः
40011253.content: किं तु however, एवं गते in this situation, यदर्थम् order, कपिराजश्च monkey king's, रामश्च and Rama's, कृतनिश्चयौ are determined, इदम् this, कार्यम् task, उपेक्षितुम् to neglect, न शक्यम् not possible.

40011253.author: Translation
40011253.content: 'However  in this situation, it is not possible for us to neglect (our task) as it is the order of the monkeyking and Rama who are determined to achieve the objective.

40011254.author: पदार्थः
40011254.content: साम्प्रतम् at this age, कालभेदेन due to advancement of age, या that, गतिः movement, ताम् that, निबोधत you know, योजनानाम् of yojanas, नवतिम् ninety,गमिष्यामि I can leap, संशयः doubt, न not.

40011254.author: Translation
40011254.content: Know the extent of my leap as lessened by age: I can spring ninety yojanas, without doubt.

40011255.author: पदार्थः
40011255.content: सर्वान् all, तान् of the monkeys, हरिश्रेष्ठान् distinguished among the monkeys, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् said, मे my, गमने in leaping, पराक्रमः valour, एतावदेव only that much, न आसीत् खलु was not.

40011255.author: Translation
40011255.content: Jambavan, the distinguished among the monkeys again said, 'My strength to leap into the sky was not only that much (I was stronger in my youth and could cover longer distances)'

40011256.author: पदार्थः
40011256.content: मया by myself, पूर्वम् earlier, महाबलेश्चैव of Mahabali, यज्ञे in yagna, क्रममाणः the advancing Lord, विष्णुः Visnu, सनातनः eternal, त्रिविक्रमः Visnu of three strides, प्रदक्षिणीकृतः circumambulated.

40011256.author: Translation
40011256.content: 'In the past, at the time of the wellknown yagna (of king Bali) I was very strong. I circumambulated the eternal Vishnu while he was taking three strides (in his incarnation of Trivikrama Vamana.)

40011257.author: पदार्थः
40011257.content: इदानीम् now, वृद्धः old, सः अहम् that I am, प्लवने to leap, मन्दविक्रमः my strength is denuded, तदा then, यौवने in youth, मे बलम् my prowess, अप्रतिमम् incomparable, परैः by others, आसीत् it was.

40011257.author: Translation
40011257.content: 'Having grown old I do not have the same courage. In my youth my prowess was incomparable and none could excel me.

40011258.author: पदार्थः
40011258.content: सम्प्रति at this time, अहम् I have, शक्तिं capacity, गमने to fly, तर्कयामि I guess, एतावतीं that much, शक्यम् possible, एतावता to this extent, अस्य of this, कार्यस्य of the objective, संसिद्धिः success, न भविष्यति will not be.

40011258.author: Translation
40011258.content: 'I guess that at this time I do not have the capacity to fly to that extent. Achieving the objective is out of question with this much of energy.

40011259.author: पदार्थः
40011259.content: अथ and now, तदा then, प्राज्ञः wise, अङ्गदः Angada, महाकपिम् great monkey, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavan, अनुमान्य doubting, उदारार्थम् in a gentle manner, उत्तरम् reply, तदा then, अब्रवीत् said.

40011259.author: Translation
40011259.content: 'Then the wise Angada said to great Jambavan, in a gentle manner about his  own strength.

40011260.author: पदार्थः
40011260.content: अहम् I, महत् great, एतत् this, योजनानाम् of yojanas, शतम् hundred, गमिष्यामि I can go, निवर्तने to return, मे my, शक्तिः capacity, स्यात् may be, न वा or not, इति thus, निश्चितम् certainly, न not known.

40011260.author: Translation
40011260.content: 'I can  certainly go to a distance of a hundred yojanas. However, I cannot say whether I will have enough capacity to return?

40011261.author: पदार्थः
40011261.content: वाक्यकोविदः skilful at speech, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, तम् him, हरिश्रेष्ठम् best of monkeys, उवाच said, हर्यृक्षसत्तम best among bears and monkeys, गमने I am going to fly, तव your, शक्तिः energy, ज्ञायते is known.

40011261.author: Translation
40011261.content: Jambavan who was skilful in speech spoke to that great Angada, 'O leader among monkeys and bears your energy to cover this distance is wellknown to us'.

40011262.author: पदार्थः
40011262.content: भवान् you, योजनानाम् of yojanas, शतं सहस्रं वा even a hundred or a thousand, गन्तुम् to go, प्रतिनिवर्तितुम् but to return, शक्तः कामम् you have the required energy, एषः this, विधिः duty, उच्यते हि not proper.

40011262.author: Translation
40011262.content: 'You can go upto even a hundred thousand yojanas and have the required energy to return also. But it is not proper to send you (because you are the heir apparent).

40011263.author: पदार्थः
40011263.content: तात dear , प्रेषयिता who orders, स्वामी lord, कथञ्चन in any way, प्रेष्यः a servant who is sent, न हि indeed, प्लवगसत्तम best of monkeys, सर्वः all, अयं जनः this group, भवता by you, प्रेष्यः to be sent.

40011263.author: Translation
40011263.content: Dear one, one who issues orders is a master and is never himself the one sent; best of monkeys, this whole assembly is yours to dispatch.

40011264.author: पदार्थः
40011264.content: परन्तप O scorcher of enemies, स्वामिभावे in a state of commander, व्यवस्थितः you are established, भवान् you, अस्माकम् for us, कलत्रम् wife, स्वामी lord, सैन्यस्य army's, कलत्रम् wife, एषा so that, गतिः proper.

40011264.author: Translation
40011264.content: 'O scorcher of enemies, you are established as the commander of the army and it is proper for us to protect you as we protect our wives.

40011265.author: पदार्थः
40011265.content: तात O dear, अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, एतस्य of this, कार्यस्य of the task, भवान् you, मूलम् the root, अपि वै and also, तस्मात् therefore, भवान् you, कलत्रवत् like the wife, सदा always, प्रतिपाल्यः should be taken care of.

40011265.author: Translation
40011265.content: 'O subduer of enemies in acomplishing this task you are the root. O dear therefore you should always be taken care of by us just like the wife looked after.

40011266.author: पदार्थः
40011266.content: अर्थस्य the objective, मूलम् root, संरक्ष्यम् should be protected, एषः this कार्यविदाम् of the accomplishers, नयः policy, मूले when root, सति when it is intact, फलो पुष्पोदयाः bearing flowers and fruits, गुणाः qualities, सिद्ध्यन्ति हि will result.

40011266.author: Translation
40011266.content: 'The root of any objective should be protected well. This is the basis of an accomplisher. Only when the roots are intact, the trees have the ability to yield flowers and fruits.

40011267.author: पदार्थः
40011267.content: सत्यविक्रम truely courageous one, तत् that, भवान् you, अस्य कार्यस्य of this task, साधने in achieving, परन्तप O subduer of enemies, अत्र there, बुद्धिविक्रमसम्पन्नः endowed with wisdom and valour, हेतुः you are the cause.

40011267.author: Translation
40011267.content: 'O warrior of proven valour O subduer of enemies in achieving this objective you are the source, being endowed with valour and wisdom.

40011268.author: पदार्थः
40011268.content: कपिसत्तम O best of monkeys, नः for us, गुरुपुत्रः son of our teacher, त्वम् you are, गुरुश्च and also a respectable guide, वयम् we, भवन्तम् you, आश्रित्य under your care, अर्थसाधने in accomplishing our objective, समर्थाः हि are capable also.

40011268.author: Translation
40011268.content: 'O best of monkeys you are the son of my guide (Vali) and respectable. We will be capable of accomplishing the goal only under your protection and guidance.

40011269.author: पदार्थः
40011269.content: अथ now, महाकपिः great monkey, वालिसूनुः Vali's son, अङ्गदः Angada, उक्तवाक्यम् having said that, महाप्राज्ञम् very wise, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavan, उत्तरं वाक्यम् in reply, प्रत्युवाच said.

40011269.author: Translation
40011269.content: Jambavan, the wise monkey having said that, Angada, the great son of Vali, replied:

40011270.author: पदार्थः
40011270.content: अहम् I am, न गमिष्यामि यदि if I will not go, अन्यः other, वानरपुङ्गवः monkey leader, न not, अस्माभिः by us, पुनः again, इदम् this, प्रायोपवेशनम् fasting to death, कार्यं खलु have to do.

40011270.author: Translation
40011270.content: 'If I do not go and no other monkey leader goes, then we have to resort to fasting unto death once again.

40011271.author: पदार्थः
40011271.content: धीमतः of the wise, तस्य हरिपतेः of the lord of monkeys, सन्देशम् message, अकृत्वा by not fulfilling, तत्र there, गत्वापि even after going, प्राणानाम् of life, परिरक्षणम् protection, न पश्यामि I do not see.

40011271.author: Translation
40011271.content: 'If I do not fulfil the objective of the wise king of monkeys I cannot save my life even after returning there (Kishkinda).

40011272.author: पदार्थः
40011272.content: सः he, हरिः monkey king, प्रसादे च in showering grace, कोपे च and vent anger, अत्यर्थम् highly, ईश्वरः all powerful, तस्य his, सन्देशम् instruction, अतीत्य in not fulfilling the task, गमने in going, विनाशः total destruction, भवेत् will be.

40011272.author: Translation
40011272.content: 'The monkey king has the authority to shower grace or give vent to his anger. If we go without fulfilling the task we will face destruction.

40011273.author: पदार्थः
40011273.content: तत् तथाहि therefore, अस्य of this, कार्यस्य of the task, गतिः advancement, अन्यथा  otherwise, न भवति will not be, तत् that, दृष्टार्थः well aware, भवानेव you alone, सञ्चिन्तयितुम् to think over well, अर्हति you should.

40011273.author: Translation
40011273.content: 'Therefore, think over well so that we do not fail ultimately. You have a vision.You should suggest means by which this mission does not misfire.'

40011274.author: पदार्थः
40011274.content: अङ्गदेन by Angada, तदा then, प्रत्युक्तः having been addressed, वीरः hero, प्लवगर्षभः bull among monkeys, सः जाम्बवान् that Jambavan, ततः then, अङ्गदम् to Angada, उत्तरम् reply, इदं वाक्यम् in these words, प्रोवाच said.

40011274.author: Translation
40011274.content: On listening to Angada's words, Jambavan, the  bull among monkeys, replied this way:

40011275.author: पदार्थः
40011275.content: वीर O hero, ते your, तस्य कार्यस्य of this task, किञ्चित् even a little, न परिहीयते nothing is balked, एषः here I am, कार्यम् task, यः who, साधयिष्यति who can achieve, सञ्चोदयामि एनम् I will inspire him.

40011275.author: Translation
40011275.content: 'O hero this work will not be balked. I will now inspire one who can achieve this task.'
